source: Weekly refresh by Claude (scheduled task). Edit freely; the next refresh replaces this file.

items.title: Springbok test weekends: shoot a fan viewing crowd at a pub or braai
items.why: The Boks play Italy on 7 Nov, France on 13 Nov and Ireland on 21 Nov, so rugby fan content will fill SA feeds all month.
items.tip: Post within a few hours of the final whistle and cut on the loudest crowd moment.

items.title: Soweto Marathon (29 Nov): plan a 'find yourself' gallery and a race-day reel
items.why: Thousands of runners start and finish at the Johannesburg Expo Centre in Nasrec and will go looking for photos of themselves.
items.tip: Announce this week that you will be shooting, then post the gallery link the same evening and ask runners to tag friends.

items.title: Black Friday (27 Nov) mini-session offer that doubles as a Christmas gift
items.why: People start planning gift buys early in November, so a clear deal with a deadline gets saved and shared.
items.tip: Slide 1 the offer, slides 2 to 4 sample shots, last slide how to book and the cut-off date.

items.title: 'Hi, I'm a photographer' intro with your single best frame
items.why: This simple self-intro format with a trending sound is popular on TikTok right now and is an easy way to show your style to new viewers.
items.tip: Open on your strongest sports or car shot in the first second and keep the whole thing under 7 seconds.

items.title: Twist carousel: build up over 4 slides, pay off on the last one
items.why: Story carousels that hold back the best image until the final slide are being shared more than ones that lead with it.
items.tip: Try 'the brief, the location, the setup, the light' and end with the final hero shot.

items.title: 'Loading' freeze-frame reveal for cars and athletes
items.why: Freeze a plain moment with a 'loading' label, then hard cut on the beat to the finished look; this structure is trending and suits car and sport work.
items.tip: Freeze on the raw car in the garage, then cut to your edited rolling shot on the drop.

items.title: 'POV: you take pics of everything' weekend photo dump
items.why: Casual photo dumps set to a song are trending and show your eye beyond paid jobs, which makes you feel more human to clients.
items.tip: Mix 6 to 10 everyday Joburg shots with one client frame so it still sells your work.

items.title: Build carousels and beat-synced reels inside the Edits app
items.why: Edits now supports carousel editing and is testing effects that sync to the music beat, and Instagram is testing a Reels-first home screen.
items.tip: Make video your default post type this month and use Edits to save time on beat cuts.

items.title: Year-end function teaser for venues and caterers
items.why: November and December are peak work party and event season in South Africa, and venues are booking content now.
items.tip: Tag the venue and caterer so they reshare, and pin a 'December dates open' comment.

items.title: Post only your own original work, no reposted clips
items.why: Instagram keeps reducing reach for accounts that mostly repost other people's content, including photos and carousels.
items.tip: If you share a client's video, add your own edit or BTS so it counts as new.
